summary: A 1940 Civilian Conservation Corps lookout with a live-in cab on an Aermotor MC-24 tower near La Cueva, NRHP-listed in 1988; one listing now says closed.

facts.design: Aermotor MC-24 tower with an R-3 live-in 14'x14' wooden cab, no catwalk

access.note: Undated Campflare listing says closed until further notice; day use only, no overnight camping. Forest Road 375 typically closed early September through spring.

events.note: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps
Registered December 7, 2007 as US 709, NM 28; nominated by Dave Lorenz
AP reported the tower long decommissioned; a forest booster group began raising up to $100,000 to rehabilitate it for rental use

notes_for_editor: Access conflict: the record says public (recreation.gov listing, not read); the undated Campflare listing says closed until further notice. Verify with the Pecos/Las Vegas Ranger District. Record height_m 20.0 has no source among pages read; a search snippet's 30-foot figure was not used. No staffing history found; a search snippet claimed staffed into the 1990s, unverified. SFNM article returned HTTP 429 and was not read. The NRHP nomination PDF OCR was unreadable and is not cited. AP text spells the archaeologist's name Bremer and then Brenner.
